$comment: Canonical SMS compliance keyword contract, shared by both runtimes.
Inbound SMS is handled in Python (backend/app/routes/sms_inbound.py) while the
preference vocabulary and the composer live in TypeScript. Rather than
duplicating the vocabulary in two languages and hoping they stay aligned,
both runtimes load THIS file and a parity test on each side fails the build
STOP semantics are carrier-mandated: a STOP suppresses ALL SMS to that
number, including transactional and operational. It is not a marketing-only
help_response: Alloy messaging. Reply STOP to unsubscribe. Msg&data rates may apply. Contact your school for assistance.
stop_response: You have been unsubscribed and will receive no further messages. Reply START to resubscribe.
start_response: You are resubscribed to messages. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.
